website.note: Pipeline subpage (/pipeline) returns 404; homepage describes subsidiaries Adimune, Pearsanta, Adivue, Evofem (acquisition no longer pursued).

excluded_preclinical: ADI-100 (Adimune subsidiary) — autoimmune therapy targeting type 1 diabetes, psoriasis, stiff person syndrome; preparing first-in-human IND submission, no IND filed at snapshot.
Pearsanta (subsidiary) — diagnostic tests (prostate cancer, endometriosis blood-based tests) using Mitomic Technology; diagnostics, not a drug pipeline.
Adivue (subsidiary) — neurological diagnostics; not a drug pipeline.
excluded_legacy_terminated: Proposed acquisition of Evofem Biosciences — terminated April 2024 by Evofem; subsequently entered Reinstatement and amended Merger Agreement; per FY2025 10-K Aditxt is no longer pursuing the Evofem acquisition.
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: No company-sponsored clinical-stage drug assets at snapshot. Lead therapeutic candidate ADI-100 (Adimune) is preclinical with planned IND in early 2026; Pearsanta/Adivue subsidiaries are diagnostics businesses; Evofem acquisition (which would have brought a commercial reproductive-health product) is no longer being pursued. ctgov returned zero sponsor-led trials.
